messages:
erin: Rolling out config-only change in the 22:15 PT change window. cfg id cfg-7755550000. Scope: routing.weights tweak, tinybatch.window reduction, and tenant idle timeout floor. Canary plan: 6% for 12m across us-west + eu-central.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by erin — canary 6% for 12m. Targets: 3 nodes us-west, 2 nodes eu-central. Rollout id cfg-7755550000. Observability: https://dash/reports/cfg-7755550000

kai: Ack. I'll run smoke: 30 synthetic hits per region, validate 5xx, 99p, and kvcache miss ratio. Alert: pause if 5xx > 0.4% OR 99p > 750ms.

marta: Suggest pinning model to v1.4-stable to avoid layout drift. Also switch on sticky routing for enterprise tenants in this change.

erin: Applied: model.pin=v1.4-stable, routing.sticky=enterprise, tinybatch.window 48ms -> 26ms, timeout.idle.background 14s -> 10s.

deploy-bot: Canary started (6%). To pause: `/deploybot pause cfg-7755550000`. To rollback: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7755550000`. Live logs: `kubectl -n prod logs -f deploy/cfg-7755550000`

ops-signal: Alert: eu-central 99p latency jumped to ~920ms at +4m. kvcache seed_miss increased for tenant-eu-proto.

kai: Throttling canary to 2% and pausing rollforward. Log shows: `WARN kvcache.prewarm: seed_miss=0.34 tenant=tenant-eu-proto`.

marta: I recommend a targeted partial rollback: revert tinybatch.window & routing.weights, keep model.pin. Command: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7755550000 --targets tinybatch,routing --reason "eu kvcache miss spike"`

erin: Running partial rollback now. Notifying CS and support that EU premium tenants may have had a brief tail spike. Scheduling kv prewarm job and will reattempt with slower ramp.

deploy-bot: Partial rollback completed at 7755550028. Canary halted. Rollback summary: tinybatch.window restored to 48ms, routing.weights reverted, model.pin retained (v1.4-stable). Next steps: run kv prewarm, monitor 99p for 15m, then retry canary with stepwise increases.
